node.statement: Second degree-two comparison. Apply lem-routef-degree-two-estimate at amplification n to the pair XY,Z. Since M_n(B) is an associative C*-algebra, ||XY||<=||X||||Y|| and (XY)Z=XYZ, so ||P4-P5||=||Phi_n(Delta_n(XY)Delta_n Z)-Delta_n((XY)Z)||<=C_2 eta||XY||||Z||<=C_2 eta||X||||Y||||Z||.
